map.推力 T=120000 N（双发合计）、重量 W=600000 N。推重比 T/: Thrust T=120000 N (both engines combined) and weight W=600000 N. Thrust-to-weight ratio T/W=120000/600000=0.2. A transport is well served by 0.2-0.4; fighters are often >0.9 or even >1 for super-manoeuvrability.
map.推重比大于 1 意味着什么？: What does a thrust-to-weight ratio greater than 1 mean?
map.推力大于重力，理论上可垂直加速（如战斗机/火箭），具备超机动与短距起飞能力。客机: Thrust exceeds weight, so in theory it can accelerate vertically (such as fighters/rockets), with super-manoeuvrability and short takeoff capability. Airliners have a thrust-to-weight ratio far below 1 and rely on
map.而非推力支撑重量。: rather than thrust to support their weight.
map.静推重比和飞行中一样吗？: Is the static thrust-to-weight ratio the same as in flight?
map.不一样。发动机在海平面静态最大推力算出的静推重比最高；随速度/高度推力变化，飞行: No. The static thrust-to-weight ratio computed from the sea-level maximum static thrust of the engine is the highest; as thrust varies with speed/altitude, the actual ratio in flight changes. Performance assessment uses the value for the relevant operating condition.
